Class ShooterIO.ShooterIOInputs

java.lang.Object
frc.robot.subsystems.shooter.ShooterIO.ShooterIOInputs
Enclosing interface:
ShooterIO
public static class ShooterIO.ShooterIOInputs extends Object
Snapshot of all shooter sensor readings for one loop cycle.

This class is a plain data holder â€” all fields are public and mutable. It also self-registers every field with OnboardLogger in its constructor, so all shooter hardware data is automatically written to the .wpilog file without any additional setup in Shooter.periodic().
